title: Self-balancing humanoid
summary: This project actually started out as a tutoring gig, when my old teacher asked me to help her student with reading and writing. I caught a glimpse of his dad's garage during a session, and found an exciting opportunity to work on humanoids. I worked on a custom gearbox for the wheeled base, designing 3D-printed components for the frame to merge with aluminum inserts. I also was solely responsible for electronics, soldering a perfboard with a Raspberry Pi, IMU, and CAN hat with connectors for multiple motor drivers + quadrature encoders (hint: the price of those is the inspiration for my newest project).
